column1: # The major flash, heard and counted.
# `audio.md §8.4` gives a recognised Word of Power the shared full-viewport
# flash, and `§3`/`§8.4` make its most testable claim: the flash draws **1,856
# gameplay-PRNG bands and retunes on every one of them, even while muted**. The
# engine implements that and unit-tests the draw count; nothing had heard it.
# The Word is spoken on the open overworld rather than at a seal.
# `commands.md §8`'s Yell context table makes the overworld the Word-of-Power
# context, and the engine's own comment on the arm records the published order:
# "the recognised-Word effect occurs before the location-specific success test,
# so a known Word spoken at the wrong place is still audible and visible". So
# the cue is reachable from any overworld seed, with no quest state at all.
# requires-seed: the party standing on the Britannia overworld
